subject: Short-notice reshuffle: consolidate executive walkthrough for FinCap
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fincap.com>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@fincap.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Short-notice reshuffle: consolidate executive walkthrough for FinCap

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for locking in time for next week. Quick note — we heard this morning that a couple of your execs have a conflict during the planned 60-min walkthrough on Thursday, and you asked if we can compress the session to keep the executive presence but still cover the integration and security highlights.

Proposed options:
- Option A (preferred): 45-minute exec walkthrough covering business outcomes + product live demo, followed by a 15-minute SE deep-dive with recording available to your team.
- Option B: Keep 60 minutes but move to Friday 10:00–11:00 PT when execs are free.

If you prefer A, we can assign Priyom to run the 15-min deep dive and capture the recording. Attached is a one-page agenda and the current SOW draft for reference.

Please let me know which you prefer and any hard no-times for exec attendees. I can rebook in a minute.

Thanks —
Avery
Avery Johnson | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0128
attachments: agenda-fincap-demo.pdf (PDF), SOW-draft-v1.docx (DOCX)

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@fincap.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@fincap.com>

Date: 2026-08-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short-notice reshuffle: consolidate executive walkthrough for FinCap

Thanks Avery —

Sorry for the last-minute ask. Exec availability was pulled into a board prep call. Option A sounds good to us if the exec portion stays focused (high level outcomes + 10–15 mins for questions). We like the idea of a recorded SE deep-dive that our technical team can review.

Can you confirm you can get the exec-friendly deck and a 5-point ROI slide at the top? Also, Tom has to drop at :30 for another meeting; can we structure time so he hears the first 30 mins?

Elena
Elena Morales | Head of Integrations | FinCap
Mobile: +1 415 555 9988

Subject: Re: Short-notice reshuffle: consolidate executive walkthrough for FinCap

Elena — good call, we can absolutely do Option A and keep it tight. Updated plan below:

Agenda (45 + 15):
- 0:00–5:00 — Quick welcome, goal alignment (Avery)
- 5:00–20:00 — Executive walkthrough: outcomes, ROI, timeline (Avery + Lauren)
- 20:00–45:00 — Live product demo focused on the FinCap integration (Priyom will do highlights; live Q&A for high-level questions)
- 45:00–60:00 — SE deep-dive (recorded) for your technical team (Priyom leads)

Tom — noted you need to drop at :30. We'll make sure the exec section and core ROI slides are frontloaded so you get the key pieces.

I'll update the calendar to a 45-min meeting with an optional 15-min follow-up slot; recording and the SE deep-dive link will be posted afterward. New calendar invite will go out in five minutes.

Avery
Avery Johnson | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

> attachments: updated-agenda-fincap.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Short-notice reshuffle: consolidate executive walkthrough for FinCap

All —

Happy to run the demo and the recorded deep-dive. A couple of practical notes from the SE side so the 45-minute flow is smooth: 
- I'll prepare a 10-minute technical summary slide (pre-demo) to surface integration points and SLO expectations.
- I'll bring a small checklist of sample data and an API token to demo the end-to-end flow quickly. Please confirm if we should demo sandbox or a redacted snippet of a FinCap dataset.
- If Tom drops at :30, I'll queue the deeper technical questions into the recorded segment so your engineers still get full answers.

Soojin — can you confirm we have recording permissions enabled on the conference? I can also push a short Loom if you prefer asynchronous distribution.

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

This plan works for us. Appreciate the frontloading of the ROI content. Confirmed: I’ll join the first 30 minutes on Thursday; Priyom please demo against a redacted FinCap sample. Procurement — we’ll continue SOW and next-step procurement in parallel (linked DocuSign).

See you Thursday.
